title: Recovery information: Rotator cuff tendinopathy
summary: Recovery varies. A health professional can assess the shoulder and discuss appropriate options. This page does not provide a personal treatment plan.

title: Recovery information: Rotator cuff tear
summary: Some tears are managed without surgery, while others need further assessment. The right approach depends on the person and the tear; consult a healthcare professional.

title: Recovery information: Shoulder bursitis
summary: The course varies and depends on the cause. A clinician can help assess ongoing or worsening symptoms.

title: Recovery information: Shoulder impingement
summary: Recovery depends on the underlying cause. Seek an assessment if symptoms are persistent, worsening, or limiting daily activities.

title: Recovery information: Shoulder dislocation
summary: A suspected dislocation needs urgent medical assessment. Do not try to put the joint back into place yourself.

title: Recovery information: Shoulder subluxation
summary: Repeated episodes or ongoing symptoms should be discussed with a healthcare professional.

title: Recovery information: Shoulder instability
summary: Repeated symptoms should be assessed. Options depend on the cause, frequency, and effect on daily life.

title: Recovery information: Shoulder labral tear
summary: A questionnaire cannot confirm a labral tear. A healthcare professional can decide whether further examination or tests are appropriate.

title: Recovery information: SLAP tear
summary: Assessment by a healthcare professional is needed to determine whether a SLAP tear is present and what care may be appropriate.

title: Recovery information: AC joint injury
summary: Injuries vary in severity. A clinician can assess the joint, especially after a fall or impact.

title: Recovery information: Biceps tendinopathy
summary: Persistent or worsening symptoms should be assessed by a healthcare professional.

title: Recovery information: Frozen shoulder
summary: Recovery can take time and varies. A healthcare professional can assess stiffness and discuss suitable care.

title: Recovery information: Shoulder fracture
summary: A suspected fracture needs medical assessment. Recovery depends on the bone and type of injury.

title: Recovery information: Muscle strain
summary: Symptoms vary. Seek advice if pain is severe, not improving, or affecting normal activities.

title: Recovery information: Shoulder sprain
summary: Severity varies. A clinician can assess significant injuries and exclude a fracture or dislocation.
